question: report of top 5 customers by revenue
sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Provide ten solid analytical insights derived from the 2025 orders data (e.g., revenue distribution, customer segmentation, trends, product performance, seasonal patterns, etc.).
sql:
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Provide ten solid analytical insights derived from the 2025 orders data (e.g., revenue distribution, customer segmentation, trends, product performance, seasonal patterns, etc.).
sql:
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM
    order_items oi
JOIN
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025
GROUP BY
    p.id,
    p.name
ORDER BY
    total_quantity_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Provide ten solid analytical insights derived from the 2025 orders data (e.g., revenue distribution, customer segmentation, trends, product performance, seasonal patterns, etc.).
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31' THEN 'Q1'
    WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'Q4'
  END AS quarter,
  SUM(o.total_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS net_revenue
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_id = o.id
WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31')
   OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31')
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter;

question: Provide ten solid analytical insights derived from the 2025 orders data (e.g., revenue distribution, customer segmentation, trends, product performance, seasonal patterns, etc.).
sql:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT p.category,
         SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_amount
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY p.category
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT p.category,
         SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  WHERE r.return_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND r.return_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT s.category,
       COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) / NULLIF(s.sales_amount, 0) AS return_rate
FROM sales s
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.category = s.category;

question: Provide ten solid analytical insights derived from the 2025 orders data (e.g., revenue distribution, customer segmentation, trends, product performance, seasonal patterns, etc.).

       SUM(o.total_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS revenue
FROM orders o

WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Provide ten solid analytical insights derived from the 2025 orders data (e.g., revenue distribution, customer segmentation, trends, product performance, seasonal patterns, etc.).
sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', c.signup_date) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS new_signups,
       COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS first_order_revenue
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.total_amount
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.id
    ORDER BY o.order_date ASC, o.id ASC
    LIMIT 1
) o ON true
WHERE c.signup_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
